exact: high affinity ferrous uptake transmembrane transporter activity
high-affinity ferrous iron uptake transmembrane transporter activity

definition: Enables the transfer of ferrous iron (Fe(II) or Fe2+) ions from one side of a membrane to the other. In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations.
label: high-affinity ferrous iron transmembrane transporter activity
